name: Vivi
source:
Witch class.
A fun-loving girl who loves to play pranks with her twin sister Pioni, another student in the witch class.
Student or professor, nobody is safe from the twins' mischief.
Sometimes they get scolded for taking their pranks too far, but Vivi is quick to forget the consequences. She enjoys their victims' reactions far too much to quit.
